audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[] and the full-layer phases both read Graves / Skill / Poppy / Poppy / Graves / Poppy / Poppy, against a packet levelChart of Skill / Skill / Graves / Graves / Graves / Graves / Skill. The lane is also tagged TRICKY at 7/10 with Poppy carry threat 7.5/10 on a 52.63% win rate.
audit.why: Rows 2, 3 and 5 are flatly contradicted by the content whys printed beside them — whys[2] 'At 3 your full kit comes online', whys[3] 'you win every extended trade her near-immobile kit walks into', whys[5] 'out-fights her base tankiness'. All three describe Graves stages that were tagged Poppy. Rows 0, 1 and 6 needed a judgement call, described below. A 52.63% lane where Graves owns four stages is not a 7/10 tricky matchup.
audit.corrected: Both charts set to the packet order Skill / Skill / Graves / Graves / Graves / Graves / Skill, ratings 5,5,7,7,7,7,5; diff EVEN, difficulty 5/10, Poppy carry threat 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1 and 6: the packet says Skill/Skill/Skill, the content prose says Poppy owns Levels 1-2 (whys[0], whys[1], spikes[3]) and reclaims 2+ items (whys[6]).
audit.why: I followed the packet, because whys[0] is internally impossible as written — it justifies a Poppy level 1 with 'her E wall-pin stun PLUS Q knockup', but at level 1 she has exactly one ability, the same as Graves. The level-2 claim rests on the same two-ability combo. Rather than leave the enums fighting the prose, I rewrote whys[0], whys[1], whys[6] and spikes[3] so the prose now says what the packet says.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 stated as even but fragile — one ability each, and the danger is positional (terrain at your back), not a combo she does not yet have.
sources: enemyKit Q and E (two separate abilities)

audit.whatIsWrong: Poppy's Q is called a knockup in whys[0], spikes[3].text, content early and wants.foe[0].
audit.why: Riot's Hammer Shock: 'Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.' It is a slow zone with a delayed detonation, 430 range, 8/7/6/5/4s. The only knockup in her kit is the R. Telling a Graves player to expect a knockup from a 4-second-cooldown ability changes how he spaces every trade, and the actual behaviour — a lingering slow zone he must step out of before it explodes — is the thing he needs to react to.
audit.corrected: Hammer Shock named, and described as a slowing zone that explodes after a delay.
sources: enemyKit Q Riot text, range 430, cd 8/7/6/5/4
enemyKit R Riot text (the actual displacement)

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup's entire trading plan is 'drop W to blind her autos' — in whys[1], whys[2], spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, content mid (twice), wants.you[1] and report[10].t.
audit.why: Graves' Smoke Screen is not a blind. Riot: 'creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.' Against Poppy specifically this is the worst possible place for the error, because she is an attack-reliant bruiser and the page tells the player his win condition is turning her autos off. It is not; the W's value here is the impact slow and the sight cut.
audit.corrected: W reframed as impact slow plus vision cut everywhere it appears.
sources: ownerKit W Riot text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Steadfast Presence is named as the matchup clock but two of its three properties are never stated: the grounding that follows a stopped dash, and the passive resists that scale up as she gets low.
audit.why: Riot: 'Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.' Both matter enormously. The grounding means a stopped Quickdraw does not just fail — Graves is then denied the dash entirely for its duration, so 'W-block the dash' understates the punishment. And the low-health resist scaling means the last third of her health bar is the hardest, which directly contradicts the page's 'chip early then stop donating shells to armor' framing.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated in dosFull[0].d and content early; the low-health resist scaling stated in dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'never names any of Poppy's abilities', and the full layer's phase text is generic Graves boilerplate throughout.
audit.why: Every full-layer phase row could have been written about any enemy. The spike order that matters — level 3 when Graves' kit completes, Level 6 for Collateral Damage against a champion whose only mobility is a 14-second Heroic Charge, first item before she affords resists — is nowhere in the full layer.
audit.corrected: phases[0]-[6] rewritten naming Heroic Charge, Hammer Shock, Steadfast Presence and Keeper's Verdict with their real cooldowns.

But she scales into a teamfight problem: her W stops your engage dives, her E wall-pin locks you for her team, and her R knockback peels you off carries. Close the lane and take your tempo lead onto the map before her armor items and CC matter more than your duel does.

notes: The packet's own defect note was right: the page never named a single Poppy ability. Fixed — Hammer Shock, Steadfast Presence, Heroic Charge and Keeper's Verdict are now used with their real cooldowns. Factual error: Poppy's Q was described as a knockup in four fields. Riot's Hammer Shock is 'damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay' on a 4-second cooldown at rank 5 — the only displacement in her kit is the R. Missing and important: Steadfast Presence does not merely stop a dash, it 'slowed and grounded' the target afterwards, and its passive Armor/MR 'increases when she is low on Health' — the second directly contradicts the page's inherited 'chip early then stop donating shells to armor' framing, since she gets tankier as she drops. Smoke Screen was called a blind in eight places, and here it was load-bearing: the stated win condition was turning an auto-attack bruiser's attacks off, which the ability cannot do.
